ladderNote: The miseres sit BETWEEN the trick bids: Little Misere ranks below seven tricks, Grand Misere below nine.
bidNotice: Choose a bid. Trick bids also need a trump suit.
partnerNotice: You may call one partner: two against two, or play alone against three.
playNotice: Following suit is compulsory; only legal cards can be chosen.
madeLine: Contract made ({{tricks}} tricks). The declaring side collects from each opponent.
failedLine: Contract failed ({{tricks}} tricks). The declaring side pays each opponent.

tutorial.info: The hand number, the contract and the trump suit are shown here.
tutorial.players: Each seat's tricks and running chips. Opponents' hands stay hidden until the settlement.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Following suit is compulsory, so illegal cards cannot be chosen.
tutorial.actions: Pick a bid from the ladder. Note that the miseres sit between the trick bids.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.

frontendHint.bostonForced: This is the only legal card — following suit is compulsory
frontendHint.bostonPushContract: You are on the declaring side — play to make the contract
